purpose: Provide one legal-domain operating procedure for intake, source control, diagnosis, specialist routing, option design, legal stress testing, implementation planning, adversarial review, verification and governed learning while preserving Human Gate control.

procedure.name: INTAKE
procedure.output: bounded legal task with user objective, jurisdiction, parties, procedural posture, urgency and consequence class

procedure.name: KNOWLEDGE
procedure.output: native corpus, official-source and authorised-material map with version/date and authority labels

procedure.name: SYSTEM MAP
procedure.output: legal/procedural map: actors, court/authority, deadlines, documents, dependencies, available remedies and unresolved facts

procedure.name: DIAGNOSIS
procedure.output: legal issues, evidentiary gaps, version conflicts, procedural risks, missing authority and bottlenecks

procedure.name: SPECIALIST ROUTING
procedure.output: bounded specialist tasks by jurisdiction and authority source

procedure.name: OPTIONS
procedure.output: materially different legal/procedural options with benefits, risks, authority basis, deadlines and reversibility

procedure.name: LEGAL STRESS TEST
procedure.output: test the preferred option against adverse facts, missing evidence, jurisdiction conflict, limitation/deadline risk, superseded law, procedural rejection and enforcement failure

procedure.name: AUTHORITY & HUMAN GATE
procedure.output: who may act, what source authorises it, what is draft-only, what requires client/lawyer/human approval, and what remains outside system authority

procedure.name: SOLUTION DESIGN
procedure.output: legal memo, draft, checklist, pleading-support package, research plan, guide update, code change or workflow change with sources and unresolved issues

procedure.name: IMPLEMENTATION
procedure.output: bounded implementation only where authorised; no autonomous legal representation, filing, current-law promotion or production corpus write

procedure.name: ADVERSARIAL REVIEW
procedure.output: counter-argument, weakest point, missing source, contrary authority, procedural failure mode, hallucination/citation risk and jurisdiction-mixing check

procedure.name: VERIFY
procedure.output: pass, fail, provisional or revise state based on source identity, locator, date/version, authority hierarchy, citation coverage and Human Gate

procedure.name: LEARN
procedure.output: governed lesson, new test, corrected guide/workflow candidate, source-gap note or research backlog item; no silent corpus/legal-status mutation

release_rules: A draft answer is not legal representation and does not create legal effect.
Current-law claims require verified source/version status.
Comparative authority is not controlling law by default.
A missing source or locator must remain visible.
Human approval cannot be inferred from previous approval of a different version or gate.
Adversarial review does not replace legal verification or Human Gate approval.
